name: Harris County Tax Assessor-Collector
notes: Researched from public hctax.net and myharriscountytax.com pages only. Online payments run through MyHarrisCountyTax (Sign In or Sign Up, or Continue as Guest); search by account number, address or owner, then Pay Bill. Fees: card 2.40% ($1.00 minimum, minimum not expressible), e-Check $0.50; $30 charge for dishonored payments. Phone payments by card only at 713-274-CARD. Taxes are due by the last business day of January. The installment agreement is for delinquent accounts (12 months standard, 24 or 36 on request, 1% monthly interest, no added penalty on homesteads) and is requested online by account number or by email, which matches the template arrangement form. eBill is enrolled with the E-Code from the bill and stops mailed bills. No automatic draft program is offered; the installment page is not an automatic bank draft. Sign-in identifier and MFA are not shown on public pages: email/none is synthetic.

guest_pay.note: Continue as Guest to search by account number, property address or owner and pay without a profile.

payment_arrangement.note: Delinquent accounts can request an installment agreement online by tax account number or by email: 12 months standard, 24 or 36 months on request.

autopay.note: There is no automatic bank draft. Pay each year online, by phone, by mail or in person, or ask about an installment agreement once the account is delinquent.

pay_by_phone.note: Credit or debit card only, 2.40% fee ($1.00 minimum); e-Checks are not taken by phone.

pay_by_mail.note: Mail the coupon with your account number to P.O. Box 4622, Houston, TX 77210-4622.

help.title: Paying property taxes online
paragraphs: Pay on MyHarrisCountyTax: sign in, create a profile, or continue as a guest, then search by account number, property address or owner, open the bill and choose Pay Bill. Several accounts can go in one transaction, and a payment can be split between current and prior-year taxes; prior-year payments apply to the oldest year first.

Cards (American Express, Discover, MasterCard, Visa, plus Visa and MasterCard debit) carry a 2.40% convenience fee with a $1.00 minimum. e-Checks cost $0.50. Both fees are non-refundable, and a dishonored or rejected payment adds a $30 administrative charge.
Online payments are on time if completed by 11:59 p.m. Central on the due date. An email confirmation is sent, and signed-in users find receipts under Payment History.

help.title: Paying by phone or mail
paragraphs: Pay by card any day, any time, by calling 713-274-2273 (713-274-CARD) with your account number; the 2.40% fee applies and e-Checks are not accepted by phone.

By mail, send the coupon and your account number to the Harris County Tax Assessor-Collector, P.O. Box 4622, Houston, TX 77210-4622. U.S. Postal Service payments must be postmarked by the last business day of January. Courier deliveries go to 1001 Preston St., Houston, TX 77002, and must arrive by the due date.

help.title: Payment Installment Plan
paragraphs: If you cannot pay in full, you can request an installment agreement once the account is delinquent. It covers all delinquent current and prior-year taxes. The standard term is 12 months; 24- or 36-month plans are available on request.

On homestead property no extra penalty is added while the agreement is in place, but interest of 1% per month accrues until paid, and the account is not sent to the collection law firm. Request a plan online with your tax account number and owner details, or by email; payment details arrive by email within a few business days. Accounts in a lawsuit, bankruptcy or pending sale may need to pre-qualify.

help.title: eBill: electronic tax bills
paragraphs: To get your tax bill by email, register for eBill with your account number and the 10-digit E-Statement Code printed in the upper right of your current bill. Once you choose electronic delivery you no longer receive annual bills by mail.
Registration for a tax year closes once bills are prepared; a new registration takes effect with the next tax year.
